title: crocus vernus subvar. albiflorus
intro: Crocus vernus subvar. albiflorus, commonly known as the white crocus, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the Iridaceae family. This plant is known for its white, bell-shaped flowers and is often used in traditional medicine for its health benefits. The white crocus is said to have therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which can help to soothe and calm the body. Bioactive constituents of the white crocus include flavonoids, glycosides, and anthocyanins, which have been shown to have antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects.
